phase_name: Measurement Execution Record Evidence Locking and Tamper Detection Rules Design
phase_japanese_name: 測定実行記録の証跡固定・改ざん検出ルール設計
purpose: Design evidence locking and tamper detection rules for Phase 19-1 and 19-2 measurement execution records, extending Phase 18-4 evidence locking principles to cover completed measurement execution records as immutable audit evidence

scope_1_execution_record_locking_procedu.description: Design the locking procedure applied to completed and format-validated Phase 19-1 and 19-2 records

step_1_confirm_format_validation_pass.action: Confirm Phase 19-4 format validation has passed for the record being locked
step_1_confirm_format_validation_pass.failure_if_not_met: Do not lock; route to Phase 19-6 return procedure

step_2_canonical_serialization.action: Serialize complete execution record to canonical JSON for hashing
serialization_rules: All JSON object keys in alphabetical order (recursive)
All timestamps in RFC 3339 UTC format
All hash values in lowercase hexadecimal
All signature values in standard Base64 (no linebreaks)

step_3_compute_record_evidence_hash.note: This hash covers sections 1-5 of the execution record in full

step_4_create_record_lock_entry.action: Create immutable lock entry for the execution record

authority_lock_signature.signature_value: Base64 of sign(lock_id + record_hash + timestamp + measurement_result_summary)

step_5_append_to_audit_trail.action: Append lock entry to immutable audit trail (append-only array)
step_5_append_to_audit_trail.storage_constraint: Append-only; never modify or delete existing entries
step_5_append_to_audit_trail.integrity_verify: Re-read lock entry after append and compare hash to confirm storage success

scope_2_tamper_detection_rules.description: Rules to detect if a locked execution record has been tampered with after locking

rule_TD_1.trigger: Whenever a locked execution record is read for verification or use in Phase 19-3
rule_TD_1.action: Recompute SHA-256+ hash of canonical_record_json and compare against record_evidence_hash in lock entry
rule_TD_1.fail_outcome: TAMPER_DETECTED → HALT (route to Phase 19-6 HALT scenario)

rule_TD_2.trigger: Whenever lock entry is read for verification
rule_TD_2.action: Verify authority_lock_signature using signer's public key
rule_TD_2.pass_condition: Signature cryptographically valid AND revocation_status=ACTIVE AND current_utc < signature_valid_to_utc
rule_TD_2.fail_condition: Signature invalid OR revoked OR expired
rule_TD_2.fail_outcome: SIGNATURE_INVALID → HALT or HOLD depending on reason (see Phase 19-6)

rule_TD_3.action: Recompute SHA-256+(lock_id + signature_value + timestamp_locked_utc) and compare against stored secondary_tamper_checksum

rule_TD_4.trigger: Before using any locked record for Phase 19-3 cross-validation
rule_TD_4.action: Confirm lock entry exists in audit trail and has not been deleted
rule_TD_4.pass_condition: Lock entry present in audit trail AND audit trail append-only integrity intact
rule_TD_4.fail_condition: Lock entry missing OR audit trail modified

rule_TD_5.action: Confirm measurement_result_summary in lock entry matches section_4 of the full execution record

scope_3_continuous_monitoring_rules.description: Rules for continuous monitoring of locked execution records between locking and Phase 19-3 cross-validation

rule_CM_1.frequency: Every 5 minutes between locking and Phase 19-3 execution
rule_CM_1.action: Run TD_1 hash recompute check on all locked execution records

rule_CM_2.action: Monitor signature_valid_to_utc for all locked records; alert if expiry < 1 hour away
rule_CM_2.alert_action: Notify authority to refresh signature before Phase 19-3 execution

rule_CM_3.action: Verify audit trail append-only integrity (no modifications, no deletions since last check)
rule_CM_3.alert_on_fail: Immediate authority notification + security incident activation

scope_4_chain_of_custody_for_records.description: Design chain of custody verification covering the full measurement record lifecycle

link_1_template_to_execution.verification: execution_record must reference phase template as structural basis; section presence matches template design

link_2_execution_to_format_validation.verification: FORMAT_VALIDATION_PASS recorded with execution_record_id reference and timestamp

link_3_format_validation_to_lock.verification: lock entry timestamp must be after format validation timestamp; format_validation_id referenced in lock entry

link_4_lock_to_cross_validation.verification: Phase 19-3 must reference lock_id from Phase 19-5; hash verification passes before use
link_4_lock_to_cross_validation.timing_constraint: Phase 19-3 cross-validation must occur after both Phase 19-1 and 19-2 records are locked

phase_19_5_completion_criteria: 5 tamper detection rules (TD_1 through TD_5) designed
3 continuous monitoring rules (CM_1 through CM_3) designed
No changes to app/ or tests/ directories
